gv_CMEEQuery.value: 'SELECT * FROM (SELECT CMEE.MEME_CK, CMEE.MEEL_EFF_DT, CMEE.MEEL_INSQ_DT, CMEE.GRGR_CK, CMEE.MEEL_ELIG_TYPE, CMEE.CSPI_ID, CMEE.CSPD_CAT, CMEE.MEEL_UPDATE_DTM,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CMEE.MEME_CK ORDER BY CMEE.MEEL_EFF_DT DESC) AS RN, PLDS.PLDS_DESC  FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR  JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK    AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%MCR%' Join FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'     JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK       JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEEL_ELIG_ENT CMEE ON CMEE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK and CMEE.MEEL_VOID_IND = 'N' LEFT JOIN Facets.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON CMEE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID  WHERE  EXISTS  (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) and TO_CHAR(CMEE.MEEL_EFF_DT,'YYYY') <= (SELECT to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY') from dual) and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT and BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D') WHERE RN = 1'

gv_BLSBQuery2.value: 'SELECT              DISTINCT BLSB.BLEI_CK, BLSB.BLBL_DUE_DT, BLSB.CSPI_ID, BLSB.PDPD_ID, BLSB.PDBL_ID, BLSB.BLSB_COV_DUE_DT, BLSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT, BLSB.BLSB_PREM_TYPE,   BLSB.SBSB_CK, BLSB.MEME_CK,             BLSB.BLSB_CREATE_DTM, BLSB.CSCS_ID, PLDS.PLDS_DESC         FROM              FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR                 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB                  on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK                 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI                  on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK                  and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'                     AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL                  on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK                     and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT > BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT              JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV                  on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID                 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLSB_SB_DETAIL BLSB                  on BLIV.BLEI_CK = BLSB.BLEI_CK                  and BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLSB.BLBL_DUE_DT              LEFT JOIN Facets.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS                  ON PLDS.CSPI_ID = BLSB.CSPI_ID        WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT >=   TO_DATE('1/1/2015','mm/dd/yyyy')        AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE('1/1/2017','mm/dd/yyyy')         and BLSB.BLSB_DISP_CD = 'R' -- bring only retroactive records         and BLSB.BLSB_BONW_ROW_IND = 'N' -- bring only New records   '

gv_BLBLQuery.value: 'SELECT              DISTINCT BLBL.BLEI_CK, BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, BLBL.BLBL_END_DT, BLBL.BLBL_CREATE_DTM, BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT, BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT, BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS,             BLBL.BLBL_DAYS_BILLED, BLBL.BLBL_SPCL_BL_IND, BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST, BLBL.BLBL_TYPE         FROM              FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR                 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI                  on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK                  and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'                     AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL                  on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK                     AND BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT              JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV                  on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID         WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT >= TO_DATE('1/1/2015','mm/dd/yyyy')         AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE('1/1/2017','mm/dd/yyyy')'

gv_BLEIQuery2.value: '           SELECT      DISTINCT BLEI.*  FROM      FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR         JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB          on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK     JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI          on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK          and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'         AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'         JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL          on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK           AND BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT > BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT       JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV          on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT >=  TO_DATE('1/1/2015','mm/dd/yyyy')    '

gv_BGBGQuery.value: 'SELECT BGBG.BGBG_CK, BGBG.BGBG_ID, BGBG.CICI_ID, BGBG.BGBG_NAME, REPLACE(BGBG.BGBG_ADDR1,CHR(10),' ') as BGBG_ADDR1, REPLACE(BGBG.BGBG_ADDR2,CHR(10),' ') as BGBG_ADDR2,  REPLACE(BGBG.BGBG_ADDR3,CHR(10),' ') as BGBG_ADDR3, BGBG.BGBG_CITY, BGBG.BGBG_STATE, BGBG.BGBG_ZIP, BGBG.BGBG_COUNTY, BGBG.BGBG_CTRY_CD, BGBG.BGBG_MCTR_TYPE, BGBG.BGBG_ORIG_EFF_DT, BGBG.BGBG_TERM_DT, BGBG.BGBG_SPLT_BILL_IND FROM FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG WHERE BGBG_ID NOT LIKE 'W%''

gv_MEPEQuery.value: 'SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM(SELECT  SBSB.SBSB_ID,   MEPE.MEME_CK, MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT, MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, MEPE.MEPE_CREATE_DTM, MEPE.MEPE_PLAN_ENTRY_DT, BLEI.BLEI_CK, row_number() over (partition by mepe.meme_ck order by mepe_term_dt desc) as sdf FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB 			JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI  			on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' 			JOIN CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL 			ON  BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 			JOIN CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID				 			JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF  				ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK         JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK         JOIN CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 				AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT AND  MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y')         where sdf = 1)        where MEPE_TERM_DT <> '31-dec-2199''

gv_BLDFQuery.value: '              SELECT              BLDF.BLEI_CK, BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT, BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT, BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT, BLDF.SYS_LAST_UPD_DTM, BLDF.SYS_USUS_ID, BLDF.SYS_DBUSER_ID         FROM              FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR              JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB                  on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI                  on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK                  and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'                  AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'             JOIN Facets.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF                  On BLDF.BLEI_Ck=BLEI.BLEI_CK           WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) '

gv_MEMDQuery.value: 'Select Distinct MEMD.MEME_CK, MEMD.MEMD_EVENT_CD, MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT, MEMD.GRGR_CK, MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT,  MEMD.MEMD_INPUT_DT, MEMD.MEMD_MCTR_MCST, MEMD.MEMD_MCTR_MCCT, MEMD.MEME_HICN, MEMD.BGBG_CK, MEMD.MEMD_MCTR_PBP, MEMD.MEMD_SEGMENT_ID	 FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK	 Join FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK Join FACETS.CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL MEMD ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEMD.MEME_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID	 WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID )  AND MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT <=  TO_DATE('1/1/2017','mm/dd/yyyy') AND  TO_DATE('1/1/2017','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT AND MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT AND MEMD_EVENT_CD  IN ('PBP','SCCC') AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT >=  TO_DATE('1/1/2015','mm/dd/yyyy') and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT < BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT and BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D''

gv_SBSBQuery.value: 'select DISTINCT SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.GRGR_CK, SBSB.SBSB_ID, SBSB.SBSB_LAST_NAME, SBSB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME, SBSB.SBSB_MID_INIT, SBSB.SBSB_TITLE, SBSB.SBSB_ORIG_EFF_DT, SBSB.SYS_LAST_UPD_DTM, GRGR.GRGR_ID  FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID	 WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID )  and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT and BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D' and GRGR.GRGR_ID  LIKE '%MCR%' '

gv_SBADQuery.value: 'Select distinct SBAD.SBSB_CK, SBAD.GRGR_CK, REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1,CHR(10),' ') as SBAD_ADDR1, REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2,CHR(10),' ') as SBAD_ADDR2,  REPLACE(SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3,CHR(10),' ') as SBAD_ADDR3, SBAD.SBAD_CITY, SBAD.SBAD_STATE, SBAD.SBAD_ZIP, SBAD.SBAD_COUNTY, SBAD.SBAD_PHONE, SBAD.SBAD_PHONE_EXT, SBAD.SBAD_EMAIL, SBAD.SYS_LAST_UPD_DTM FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK	 Join FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK and SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = SBSB.sbad_type_mail  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID	 WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT and BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'    '

gv_MEMEQuery.value: 'select DISTINCT MEME.MEME_CK, MEME.GRGR_CK, MEME.SBSB_CK, MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME, MEME.MEME_MID_INIT, MEME.MEME_ORIG_EFF_DT, MEME.MEME_SEX, MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT, MEME.MEME_HICN, MEME.MEME_ELIG_DT, MEME.SYS_LAST_UPD_DTM FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK	 Join FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID	 WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID )  and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT and BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'  AND MEME.MEME_REL='M' '

gv_BLEIQuery.value: '                      SELECT      DISTINCT BLEI.BLEI_CK, BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL, BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE, BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT, BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_END_DT,     BLEI.BLEI_LAST_BILL_DTM, BLEI.BLEI_PCS_STS, BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND, BLEI.BLEI_LST_TL_DUE_DT FROM      FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR         JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB          on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK     JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI          on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK          and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'         AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'         JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL          on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK           AND BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT < BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT       JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV          on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID )  AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT >=  TO_DATE('1/1/2015','mm/dd/yyyy')  AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE('1/1/2017','mm/dd/yyyy')    '

gv_BLSBQuery.value: 'SELECT              DISTINCT BLSB.BLEI_CK, BLSB.BLBL_DUE_DT, BLSB.CSPI_ID, BLSB.PDPD_ID, BLSB.PDBL_ID, BLSB.BLSB_COV_DUE_DT, BLSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT, BLSB.BLSB_PREM_TYPE,   BLSB.SBSB_CK, BLSB.MEME_CK,             BLSB.BLSB_CREATE_DTM, BLSB.CSCS_ID,   PLDS.PLDS_DESC         FROM              FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR                 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB                  on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK                 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI                  on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK                  and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'                     AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL                  on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK                     and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT              JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV                  on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID                 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLSB_SB_DETAIL BLSB                  on BLIV.BLEI_CK = BLSB.BLEI_CK                  and BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLSB.BLBL_DUE_DT              LEFT JOIN Facets.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS                  ON PLDS.CSPI_ID = BLSB.CSPI_ID        WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT >=  TO_DATE('1/1/2015','mm/dd/yyyy')         AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE('1/1/2017','mm/dd/yyyy')'

gv_SBCSQuery.value: 'SELECT DISTINCT SBCS.SBSB_CK, SBCS.SBCS_EFF_DT, SBCS.SBCS_TERM_DT, SBCS.CSCS_ID FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBCS_CLASS SBCS ON SBCS.SBSB_CK =  SBSB.SBSB_CK WHERE     EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) and SBCS.SBCS_EFF_DT <=  TO_DATE('1/1/2017','mm/dd/yyyy') and  TO_DATE('1/1/2017','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN SBCS.SBCS_EFF_DT AND SBCS.SBCS_TERM_DT and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT and BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D''

gv_CMEEQuery.value: 'SELECT * FROM (SELECT CMEE.MEME_CK, CMEE.MEEL_EFF_DT, CMEE.MEEL_INSQ_DT, CMEE.GRGR_CK, CMEE.MEEL_ELIG_TYPE, CMEE.CSPI_ID, CMEE.CSPD_CAT, CMEE.MEEL_UPDATE_DTM,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CMEE.MEME_CK ORDER BY CMEE.MEEL_EFF_DT DESC) AS RN, PLDS.PLDS_DESC  FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR  JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK    AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%MCR%' Join FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'     JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK       JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID  JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEEL_ELIG_ENT CMEE ON CMEE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK and CMEE.MEEL_VOID_IND = 'N' LEFT JOIN Facets.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON CMEE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID  WHERE  EXISTS  (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_DELINQUENCY_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) and TO_CHAR(CMEE.MEEL_EFF_DT,'YYYY') <= (SELECT to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY') from dual) and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT and BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D') WHERE RN = 1'

DECLARE @Amount decimal(10,2)
SELECT @Amount = ISNULL(sum(cast(replace(premdue, '$','') as decimal(10,2))),0.00) from delinquency.letter where batchid = @BatchId AND OUTFIND<>'30NOT'

DECLARE @MemberCnt INT 
SELECT @MemberCnt = ISNULL(count(hcid),'') from delinquency.letter where batchid = @BatchId AND OUTFIND<>'30NOT'

UPDATE  B SET B.DelinquentAmount =  @Amount, B.InvoiceCnt = @MemberCnt from delinquency.batch b join delinquency.letter  L  
on b.batchid = l.batchid where B.batchid = @BatchId
SELECT INVOICECNT FROM DELINQUENCY.BATCH WHERE BATCHID = @BatchId
SELECT CAST(DELINQUENTAMOUNT AS varchar) FROM DELINQUENCY.BATCH WHERE BATCHID = @User::BatchId

    WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID
)
and TO_CHAR(CMEE.MEEL_EFF_DT,'YYYY') <= (SELECT to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY') from dual)
and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT
and BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D') WHERE RN = 1'
